thread:
lina: deploy-bot just flagged a eu-west canary for billing-api. sudden DB connection surge after chart v3.2.0 deployed; suggested quarantine and hold promotion.
deploy-bot: [automated] Canary anomaly: 8/10 pods > 300 DB conns; latency p95 up 600ms; recommend quarantine.
devon: confirming metrics: replicas show ~350 -> 1200 active conns across hosts. Some DB pool timeouts observed.
sam: change window closes in ~25m. Product prefers avoiding image rollback if possible. Options = hotpatch values, pin chart, or full rollback. Thoughts?
lina: quick diff of merged values: connection.pool.max: 100 -> 400, connection.pool.init: 10 -> 50. looks like an accidental bump in the chart PR.
devon: safest fast path is values hotpatch in canary namespace and re-verify for 10m. If error rate > 1% for 10m we rollback images. Also consider HPA cap to avoid amplification.
sam: agree. we need release note entry and audit trail if we do manual change. @release-ops can you file the emergency change note and tag compliance?
release-ops: filing EMERGENCY-CHANGE ticket and will open a small release-notes PR. Need 1x eng + 1x compliance signoff for the audit. pinging security.
sre-oncall: impact note: host FD usage approaching limits on a couple nodes, some pods with OOM-kill traces. Hotpatch should reduce pressure quickly. I'll mute noisy alerts for 10m and add a temporary traffic-split to 0% if errors spike.
lina: executing hotpatch now. Command plan:
```
helm upgrade billing-canary charts/billing -n billing-canary --reuse-values --set connection.pool.max=100,connection.pool.init=10
kubectl patch hpa billing-canary -n billing-canary -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":5}}'
kubectl rollout status deploy/billing-canary -n billing-canary
```
After that we'll monitor DB conns + error rate for 10 minutes.
devon: running helm upgrade.
devon: helm upgrade OK. pods rolling; one restarted with an OOM but came back healthy.
sre-oncall: DB conns dropped to baseline within 2m. HPA patched. Muted alerts for 10m.
release-ops: release notes PR: https://git.redwood/release-notes/PR-4389 12 tagging compliance/security for signoff. Draft blurb: "Emergency: reverted connection.pool values in eu-west canary after unintended bump in chart v3.2.0; hotpatch applied pending CI schema fix."
sam: thanks. follow-up task: add CI validation to reject pool.max > 200 by default. I'll open a ticket.
lina: leaving thread open for final decision. If any regression within 15m we'll perform full image rollback to v3.1.8. Otherwise we promote chart with the pinned values recorded in the release notes.
